import json,collections
def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    c=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(c,key=c.get)
    # flood fill bg from border through 4-connectivity
    reach=set()
    st=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==bg]
    while st:
        a,b=st.pop()
        if (a,b) in reach: continue
        reach.add((a,b))
        for ni,nj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and I[ni][nj]==bg: st.append((ni,nj))
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if I[i][j]==bg and (i,j) not in reach: O[i][j]=4
    return O
I=G['Test input']
O=solve(I)
